/*
Collecting Entities
*/
if CLIENT then
local CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE = {}
local CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = 0

local function CuttaQS_GetCollectObjectiveEntities(ply)
if CurTime() < CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT then
return CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE
end

CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = CurTime() + 0.2
CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE = {}
for _, v in ipairs(ents.GetAll()) do
if cutta_quest_system:Objective_PlyEntityCheck_Quest(ply,v) then
table.insert(CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE, v)
end
end

return CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_EntPos_Hud(objdata)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local localPos = LocalPlayer():GetPos()
for _, v in ipairs(CuttaQS_GetCollectObjectiveEntities(ply)) do
if not IsValid(v) then continue end
local point = v:GetPos() + Vector(0,0,v:OBBMaxs().z) -- Gets the position of the entity, specifically the center
local data2D = point:ToScreen() -- Gets the position of the entity on your screen
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawArrowOverPoint(data2D.x,data2D.y,data2D.x,data2D.y)
if localPos:DistToSqr(v:GetPos()) > 50000 then continue end
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawTextOverPoint("Collect",data2D.x,data2D.y)
end
else
CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE = {}
CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = 0
end
end
end

if SERVER then
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_SpawnCollectibles(ply,objdata)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not istable(objdata) then return end
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and globalId ~= "" and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_GetInstance then
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
local objIndex = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or nil
if inst and objIndex then
inst.spawnedForObj = inst.spawnedForObj or {}
if inst.spawnedForObj[objIndex] then
return
end
inst.spawnedForObj[objIndex] = true
end
end

local delay = 0
local entitytable = objdata and (objdata.entities or objdata["entities"]) or {}
for i = 1, #entitytable do
local v = entitytable[i]
if v.class and v.position then
timer.Simple(delay,function()
cutta_quest_system:Objective_CreateEntity(v.class,v.position,ply,v.required,v.health,v.model,nil,nil)
--cutta_quest_system:Objective_CreateEntity(v.class,v.position,ply,true,v.health,v.model,nil,nil)
end)
delay = delay+0.1
end
end
end
--Objective Entity Creation
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_CreateEntity(entclass,position,ply,isobj,health,model,isnpc,weapon,angle,datatable) --1,class 2,position, 3,player, 4,MustRemove/Kill 5,Health 6,entity model 7,is it npc 8,npc weapon 9,angle 10,datatable
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not isstring(entclass) or entclass == "" then return end
if not isvector(position) then return end
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
local ent
if isnpc then
for _numb,_info in pairs(list.Get( "NPC" )) do
if _numb == entclass then
ent = ents.Create(_info.Class)
if _info.Model then
if _info.Model then
ent:SetModel(tostring(_info.Model))
end
end
end
end
else
ent = ents.Create(entclass)
end
if not IsValid(ent) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,tostring(entclass).." Doesnt Exist")
return
end
local normalizedModel = isstring(model) and string.Trim(model) or ""
local displayModelKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "DisplayModel"
local displaySequenceKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "DisplaySequence"
local normalizedSequence = istable(datatable) and isstring(datatable["seq"]) and string.Trim(datatable["seq"]) or ""
ent:SetNWEntity(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwner", ply) -- check objective entity ownerships
local ownerObjNumb = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or 0
ent:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveObjNumb", ownerObjNumb)
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and globalId ~= "" then
ent:SetNWString(globalIdKey, globalId)
end

-- Cache ownership/objective metadata for robust remove handling when NW state is unavailable.
ent.CUTTAQS_ObjectiveOwner = ply
ent.CUTTAQS_ObjectiveObjNumb = ownerObjNumb
ent.CUTTAQS_GlobalQuestId = (isstring(globalId) and globalId ~= "") and globalId or nil

local wallMount = istable(datatable) and datatable.wall_mount and true or false
if wallMount then
ent:SetPos(position)
else
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,1))
end
if entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" and normalizedModel ~= "" then
ent:SetModel(normalizedModel)
end

if entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent:SetNWString(displayModelKey, normalizedModel)
ent:SetNWString(displaySequenceKey, normalizedSequence)
end

-- Set angle BEFORE spawning to avoid physics overriding it
if isangle(angle) then
ent:SetAngles(angle)
end

ent:Spawn()

if entclass == "cutta_quest_item" then
ent:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_NONE)
ent:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS)
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,ent:OBBMaxs().z))
elseif entclass == "cutta_quest_puzzle" then
if wallMount then
if istable(datatable) and IsValid(datatable.parentEnt) and isvector(datatable.localPos) and isangle(datatable.localAng) then
ent:SetParent(datatable.parentEnt)
ent:SetLocalPos(datatable.localPos)
ent:SetLocalAngles(datatable.localAng)
end
else
-- Spawn slightly higher so the keypad model doesn't clip into the ground.
ent:SetPos(position + Vector(0, 0, 24))
end
elseif entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,2))
if isangle(angle) then
ent:SetAngles(Angle(0,angle.yaw or angle.y or 0,0))
end
ent.NPCDataInfo = datatable
else
ent:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_NPC_SCRIPTED)
end
if isobj then -- is entity required
ent:SetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwned",true)
else
ent:SetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwned",false)
end
if health then
if health > 0 then
timer.Simple(0,function()
if ent:IsValid() then
ent:SetHealth(health)
end
end)
end
end
if normalizedModel ~= "" then
timer.Simple(0,function()
if ent:IsValid() then
ent:SetModel(normalizedModel)
if entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent.NPCDataInfo = istable(ent.NPCDataInfo) and ent.NPCDataInfo or {}
ent.NPCDataInfo["GetBonePos"] = ent:GetBonePosition(4)
end
if entclass != "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent:PhysicsDestroy()
ent:PhysicsInit(SOLID_VPHYSICS)
ent:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS)
ent:SetSolid(SOLID_VPHYSICS)
local phys = ent:GetPhysicsObject()
if IsValid(phys) then
phys:Wake()
phys:EnableMotion(true) -- Ensure it can move
end
else
local function applySequenceById(sequenceId)
if not (isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0) then return false end
ent:ResetSequence(sequenceId)
ent:ResetSequenceInfo()
ent:SetCycle(0)
ent:SetPlaybackRate(1)
return true
end

local function resolveProvidedSequenceId(sequenceName)
if not isstring(sequenceName) or sequenceName == "" then return -1 end

local asNumber = tonumber(sequenceName)
if isnumber(asNumber) and asNumber >= 0 then
return math.floor(asNumber)
end

local direct = ent:LookupSequence(sequenceName)
if isnumber(direct) and direct >= 0 then
return direct
end

local targetLower = string.lower(sequenceName)
local seqList = ent:GetSequenceList() or {}
for _, seqName in ipairs(seqList) do
if string.lower(seqName) == targetLower then
local resolved = ent:LookupSequence(seqName)
if isnumber(resolved) and resolved >= 0 then
return resolved
end
end
end

for _, seqName in ipairs(seqList) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if string.find(seqLower, targetLower, 1, true) or string.find(targetLower, seqLower, 1, true) then
local resolved = ent:LookupSequence(seqName)
if isnumber(resolved) and resolved >= 0 then
return resolved
end
end
end

if string.StartWith(string.upper(sequenceName), "ACT_") then
local activityId = _G[string.upper(sequenceName)]
if isnumber(activityId) then
local weighted = ent:SelectWeightedSequence(activityId)
if isnumber(weighted) and weighted >= 0 then
return weighted
end
end
end

return -1
end

local function applyFallbackIdle()
for _, seqName in ipairs(ent:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
if string.match(seqName, "idle") then
if applySequenceById(ent:LookupSequence(seqName)) then
return true
end
end
end
return applySequenceById(ent:LookupSequence("idle_all"))
end

local attempts = 0
local maxAttempts = 6
local function tryApplySequence()
if not IsValid(ent) then return end
attempts = attempts + 1

local sequenceApplied = false
if normalizedSequence ~= "" then
sequenceApplied = applySequenceById(resolveProvidedSequenceId(normalizedSequence))
end

if not sequenceApplied and normalizedSequence == "" then
sequenceApplied = applyFallbackIdle()
end

if sequenceApplied or attempts >= maxAttempts then
if not sequenceApplied and normalizedSequence ~= "" then
applyFallbackIdle()
end
return
end

timer.Simple(0.05, tryApplySequence)
end

tryApplySequence()
end
end
end)
end
if weapon then
if ent:IsNPC() then
ent:Give(weapon)
end
end

if cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) == "destroy" then
if health then
ent:SetMaxHealth(health)
ent:SetHealth(health)
else
if ent:Health() == nil or ent:Health() <= 50 then
ent:SetMaxHealth(100)
ent:SetHealth(100)
end
end
end
if ent:IsNPC() or ent:IsNextBot() then
ent:AddFlags(FL_NOTARGET)
if ent.SetEnemy then
ent:SetEnemy(ply,true)
end
end
if not cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
cutta_quest_system.entitylist = {}
end
cutta_quest_system.entitylist[ent:EntIndex()] = ent

return ent
end
--Objective Entity Removal
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_RemoveEntities(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(v) then
local globalId = v:GetNWString(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId", "")
if isstring(globalId) and globalId ~= "" then
continue
end
end
if cutta_quest_system:Objective_PlyEntityCheck(ply,v) then
v:Remove()
end
end
end
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_EntityOBJCheck(ply) --Objective Entity Check If Got Actually Objective Entity
local check = false
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local plyGlobalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
local plyObjNumb = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or 0
for k,v in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(v) then
if v:GetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwned",false) then
local entObjNumb = tonumber(v:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) or 0
if plyObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb ~= plyObjNumb then continue end
local entGlobalId = v:GetNWString(globalIdKey, "")
if plyGlobalId and plyGlobalId ~= "" and entGlobalId == plyGlobalId then
check = true
else
local owner = v:GetNWEntity(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwner")
if IsValid(owner) and owner == ply then
check = true
end
end
end
end
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_PlyEntityCheck(ply,ent) --Objective Entity Check
local check = false
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if IsValid(ent) then
local plyObjNumb = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or 0
local entObjNumb = tonumber(ent:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) or 0
if plyObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb ~= plyObjNumb then
return false
end
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(globalIdKey, "")
local plyGlobalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if plyGlobalId and plyGlobalId ~= "" and entGlobalId == plyGlobalId then
check = true
else
local owner = ent:GetNWEntity(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwner")
if IsValid(owner) and owner == ply then
check = true
end
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_PlyEntityCheck_Quest(ply,ent) --Objective Entity Check
local check = false
if not ent then return false end
if not ent:IsValid() then return false end
if ent:GetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwned",false) then
local plyObjNumb = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or 0
local entObjNumb = tonumber(ent:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) or 0
if plyObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb > 0 and entObjNumb ~= plyObjNumb then
return false
end
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(globalIdKey, "")
local plyGlobalId = ply and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if plyGlobalId and plyGlobalId ~= "" and entGlobalId == plyGlobalId then
check = true
else
local owner = ent:GetNWEntity(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwner")
if IsValid(owner) and owner == ply then
check = true
end
end
end
return check
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Creator_Panel(newframe)
if not IsValid(newframe) then return end
local dockmarg = cutta_ui_library:Get_StartFrame_DockMargin(newframe)
newframe.newpanel = cutta_ui_library:Panel(newframe,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["FILL"],dockmarg,nil,30)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local newpanel4 = cutta_ui_library:Panel(newframe.newpanel,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"],dockmarg,"Editor",30)
local editorframe = cutta_ui_library:Panel(newframe.newpanel,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["FILL"],dockmarg,nil,30)

editorframe.modelframe = cutta_ui_library:Panel(editorframe,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["RIGHT"],dockmarg,nil,300)
editorframe.ActiveAdjustedCosmeticID = editorframe.ActiveAdjustedCosmeticID or nil

local function ReapplyEditorPreviewAttachments()
if not IsValid(editorframe) or not IsValid(editorframe.model) then return end
editorframe.model.AttachedModels = editorframe.model.AttachedModels or {}

if ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] then
for id, data in pairs(ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"]) do
if not data or not data.added then continue end
local modelpath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_MODEL_GET(id)
if not modelpath then continue end
if editorframe.model.AttachedModels[id] then
editorframe.model.AttachedModels[id]:Remove()
editorframe.model.AttachedModels[id] = nil
end
if editorframe.model.AddAttachedProp then
editorframe.model:AddAttachedProp(id, modelpath, data)
end
end
end
end

local function RebuildEditorPreviewModel(modelPath)
if not IsValid(editorframe) or not IsValid(editorframe.modelframe) then return end

local nextModelPath = modelPath or LocalPlayer():GetModel()
if not isstring(nextModelPath) or nextModelPath == "" then
nextModelPath = LocalPlayer():GetModel()
end

if IsValid(editorframe.model) then
editorframe.model:Remove()
end

editorframe.model = cutta_ui_library:PModel(editorframe.modelframe, nextModelPath, false)
editorframe.lastPreviewModelPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(nextModelPath)
ReapplyEditorPreviewAttachments()

if editorframe.ActiveAdjustedCosmeticID and IsValid(editorframe.editframe) then
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Editor_ItemAdjust(editorframe.editframe, editorframe.ActiveAdjustedCosmeticID, editorframe.model)
end
end

local function RefreshEditorPreviewModel(force)
local liveModel = LocalPlayer():GetModel()
local normalizedLiveModel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(liveModel)
if normalizedLiveModel == "" then return end

if not force and IsValid(editorframe.model) and editorframe.lastPreviewModelPath == normalizedLiveModel then
return
end

RebuildEditorPreviewModel(liveModel)
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Editor_ItemAdjust(frame, cosmeticid, model)
if not IsValid(frame) or not IsValid(model) or not cosmeticid then return end
for k,v in pairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
v:Remove()
end

local title = cutta_ui_library:Panel(frame,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"],cutta_ui_library:Get_StartFrame_DockMargin(frame),"Adjust Item Position",30)

local itemmodel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_MODEL_GET(cosmeticid)

-- obtain the DModelPanel entity (support your wrapper)
local targetEnt = model.SelfModel or (model.GetEntity and model:GetEntity())
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end

-- Use the PModel helper so attachments are always created/drawn consistently
local existing = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] or {}
local initialData = {
posx = existing.posx or 0,
posy = existing.posy or 0,
posz = existing.posz or 0,
pitch = existing.pitch or 0,
yaw = existing.yaw or 0,
roll = existing.roll or 0,
boneselect = existing.boneselect or "ValveBiped.Bip01_Head1",
scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(existing.scale)
}
local attach = nil
if model and model.AddAttachedProp then
attach = model:AddAttachedProp(cosmeticid, itemmodel, initialData)
end

-- Add to temporary table and indicate it's been added (or load existing values)
if not ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] then
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] = {}
end

local existing = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] or {}
local itempos_init = {}
itempos_init["posx"] = existing.posx or 0
itempos_init["posy"] = existing.posy or 0
itempos_init["posz"] = existing.posz or 0
itempos_init["pitch"] = existing.pitch or 0
itempos_init["yaw"] = existing.yaw or 0
itempos_init["roll"] = existing.roll or 0
itempos_init["boneselect"] = existing.boneselect or "ValveBiped.Bip01_Head1"
itempos_init["scale"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(existing.scale)

ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] or {}
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].model = itemmodel
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].cosmetic_id = cosmeticid
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].added = true
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posx = itempos_init["posx"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posy = itempos_init["posy"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posz = itempos_init["posz"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].pitch = itempos_init["pitch"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].yaw = itempos_init["yaw"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].roll = itempos_init["roll"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].boneselect = itempos_init["boneselect"]
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].scale = itempos_init["scale"]
-- default pet animation: prefer item-defined PetAnimation, else existing or idle
local iteminfo_for_anim = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)
local defaultPetAnim = (iteminfo_for_anim and iteminfo_for_anim.PetAnimation) or existing.petanimation or "idle"
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].petanimation = defaultPetAnim

-- Ensure the model panel has our attachment registered (AddAttachedProp already does this)
if model and model.AddAttachedProp then
model.AttachedModels = model.AttachedModels or {}
model.AttachedModels[cosmeticid] = attach
else
model.AttachedModels = model.AttachedModels or {}
model.AttachedModels[cosmeticid] = attach
end

-- If this cosmetic is a pet, immediately play its animation in the editor preview
if IsValid(attach) and iteminfo_for_anim and iteminfo_for_anim.IsPet == "true" then
local animToPlay = defaultPetAnim
if animToPlay and animToPlay ~= "" then
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Play_PetAnimation(attach, animToPlay)
end
end

local bonetext = cutta_ui_library:Panel(frame,cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"],cutta_ui_library:Get_StartFrame_DockMargin(frame),"Select Bone to Attach To:",30)

local boneButton = cutta_ui_library:SelectionButton(frame, "Select Bone", cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], dockmarg, nil, false, function()
local options = {}
for _, bone in ipairs(bonechoose) do
local display, dat = bone[1], bone[2]
options[display] = {
icon = "",
func = function()
if not IsValid(attach) then return end
-- set the label on the button to the selected display name
if bonetext then bonetext.Text = "Select Bone to Attach To: "..display end
-- persist the bone selection
if ply and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] then
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].boneselect = dat
end
-- compute bone matrix on the model panel entity and move the attach into that space
if not IsValid(targetEnt) then return end
if not targetEnt.LookupBone then return end
local boneIndex = targetEnt:LookupBone(dat)
if not boneIndex or boneIndex < 0 then
-- fallback: unparent and keep at local offsets relative to model origin
attach:SetParent(nil)
local origin = targetEnt:GetPos()
local ang = targetEnt:GetAngles()
local lp = Vector(ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posx or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posy or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posz or 0)
local la = Angle(ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].pitch or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].yaw or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].roll or 0)
local fp, fa = LocalToWorld(lp, la, origin, ang)
attach:SetPos(fp)
attach:SetAngles(fa)
attach:SetupBones()
return
end
local mat = targetEnt:GetBoneMatrix(boneIndex)
if not mat then return end
local bonePos = mat:GetTranslation()
local boneAng = mat:GetAngles()
local lp = Vector(ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posx or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posy or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posz or 0)
local la = Angle(ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].pitch or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].yaw or 0, ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].roll or 0)
local finalPos, finalAng = LocalToWorld(lp, la, bonePos, boneAng)
attach:SetParent(nil)
attach:SetPos(finalPos)
attach:SetAngles(finalAng)
attach:SetupBones()
if model and model.LayoutEntity and model.SelfModel then
model:LayoutEntity(model.SelfModel)
end
end
}
end
local dmenu = cutta_ui_library:DermaMenu(options)
end)

-- set initial label on the button based on saved selection
for _, bone in ipairs(bonechoose) do
if bone[2] == (itempos_init.boneselect or "") then
bonetext.Text = "Select Bone to Attach To: "..bone[1]
end
end

-- boneButton OnSelect is now handled by the DermaMenu opened from the button

-- local offsets (used when parented/following bone)
local localPos = Vector(itempos_init.posx or 0,itempos_init.posy or 0,itempos_init.posz or 0)
local localAng = Angle(itempos_init.pitch or 0,itempos_init.yaw or 0,itempos_init.roll or 0)
local localScale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(itempos_init.scale)

-- ensure initial offsets are applied
if IsValid(attach) then
attach:SetLocalPos(localPos)
attach:SetLocalAngles(localAng)
if attach.SetModelScale then
attach:SetModelScale(localScale, 0)
end
end

-- PModel will use the saved bone and offsets to position attachments each frame

local function ApplyOffsets()
if not IsValid(attach) then return end
-- when parented or following a bone, use local transforms
attach:SetLocalPos(localPos)
attach:SetLocalAngles(localAng)
if attach.SetModelScale then
attach:SetModelScale(localScale, 0)
end
-- persist offsets to temp props
if ply and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] then
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posx = localPos.x
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posy = localPos.y
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].posz = localPos.z
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].pitch = localAng.p
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].yaw = localAng.y
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].roll = localAng.r
ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(localScale)
end
end

-- ensure the attach is removed when the editor panel is closed
frame.OnRemove = function()
if IsValid(attach) then attach:Remove() end
end

-- put sliders in a scroll panel so they can't be cut off
local sliderScroll = vgui.Create("DScrollPanel", frame)
sliderScroll:Dock(FILL)
sliderScroll:DockMargin(0,5,0,5)

for k,v in pairs(itempos_init) do
if k == "boneselect" then
continue
end

local minv, maxv, dec = (k:find("pos") and -300 or -180), (k:find("pos") and 300 or 180), 1
if k == "scale" then
minv, maxv, dec = 0.05, 1, 2
end

local DermaNumSlider = cutta_ui_library:NumSlider(sliderScroll, cutta_ui_library["DockMode"]["TOP"], {0,10,0,0}, nil, k, minv, maxv, dec, v)
-- cutta_ui_library:NumSlider handles label, min, max, decimals and value

DermaNumSlider.OnValueChanged = function( self, value )
if k == "posx" then localPos.x = value end
if k == "posy" then localPos.y = value end
if k == "posz" then localPos.z = value end
if k == "pitch" then localAng.p = value end
if k == "yaw" then localAng.y = value end
if k == "roll" then localAng.r = value end
if k == "scale" then localScale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(value) end
ApplyOffsets()
end

end

if cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_TYPE_CHECK(cosmeticid) == "IsPet" then
if IsValid(attach) then
local petinfo = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticid)
if petinfo and petinfo.Animations then
local petanims = petinfo.Animations
local petanimoptions = {}
for _, animname in ipairs(petanims) do
petanimoptions[animname] = {
icon = "",
func = function()
if not IsValid(attach) then return end
-- update saved temp props so the PModel paint loop advances this sequence
local ply_local = LocalPlayer()
if ply_local and ply_local["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] and ply_local["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid] then
ply_local["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][cosmeticid].petanimation = animname
end
-- play immediately
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Play_PetAnimation(attach, animname)
end
}
end
local dmenu = cutta_ui_library:DermaMenu(petanimoptions)
end
end
end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_SecurityCode()

local randomchars = {"q","w","e","r","t","y","u","i","o",

"p","a","s","d","f","g","h","j","k","l",

"z","x","c","v","b","n","m"}

local rnd1 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd2 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd3 = table.Random(randomchars)

local rnd4 = table.Random(randomchars)

local RandomId1 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4)

local RandomId2 = tostring(rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1)

local RandomId3 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2)

local RandomId4 = tostring(rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3)

local RandomId5 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd1..""..rnd4..""..rnd2)

local RandomId6 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd3..""..rnd2..""..rnd4)

local chance = math.random(1,6)

if chance == 1 then

return RandomId1

elseif chance == 2 then

return RandomId2

elseif chance == 3 then

return RandomId3

elseif chance == 4 then

return RandomId4

elseif chance == 5 then

return RandomId5

elseif chance == 6 then

return RandomId6

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_ItemName(class)

if not cutta_inventory_system:Check_ItemValid(class) then

return ""

end

return cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]["Name"]

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_ItemModel(class)

return cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]["Model"]

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_ItemType(class)

if not cutta_inventory_system:Check_ItemValid(class) then

return cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]["Type"]

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_ItemPrice(class)

if not cutta_inventory_system:Check_ItemValid(class) then

return 0

end

return cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class]["Price"]

end

local function CIS_GetItemData(itemOrClass)

if istable(itemOrClass) then

return itemOrClass

end

if not isstring(itemOrClass) or itemOrClass == "" then

return nil

end

return cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][itemOrClass]

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Is_ItemBuyEnabled(itemOrClass)

local itemData = CIS_GetItemData(itemOrClass)
if not istable(itemData) then return false end

return itemData.BuyEnabled != false

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Is_ItemSellEnabled(itemOrClass)

local itemData = CIS_GetItemData(itemOrClass)
if not istable(itemData) then return false end

return itemData.SellEnabled != false

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Check_ItemValid(class)

if cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

return true

end

return false

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if isstring(slot) then

return slot != "" and slot or nil

end

if not istable(slot) then return nil end

local class = slot.Class or slot.class

if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return nil end

return class

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then return 0 end

if isstring(slot) then return 1 end

local function CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(ply, wep, key)

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return 0 end

-- TacRP integration:

-- TacRP computes weapon stats via SWEP:GetValue() and allows modification through hook.Run("TacRP_Stat_" .. stat).

-- We apply Cutta inventory upgrades there so stats update correctly without fighting TacRP's cache.

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Max", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMax", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Min", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMin", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ClipSize", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_ClipSize", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local clip = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ClipSize")

if clip <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + clip

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RPM", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_RPM", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rpmUpg = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "RPM")

if rpmUpg <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + (rpmUpg * 5)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Spread", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Accuracy", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local acc = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Accuracy")

if acc <= 0 then return end

-- TacRP uses very small spread values (e.g., ~0.004), so use a smaller scaling than the legacy StatCache path.

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (acc * 0.0002)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RecoilKick", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Recoil", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rec = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Recoil")

if rec <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (rec * 0.05)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ReloadTimeMult", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Reload", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local res = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ReloadSpeed")

if res <= 0 then return end

-- Lower ReloadTimeMult = faster reload.

local mult = math.Clamp(1 - (res * 0.05), 0.5, 1)

data.mul = (data.mul or 1) * mult

end)

function cutta_inventory_system:Paint_REPanel(w, h, variant)

local border = theme.borderSoft

elseif variant == "accent" then

border = theme.border
elseif variant == "warning" then
fill = Color(46, 31, 22, 235)
border = theme.warning
end

surface.SetDrawColor(border)
surface.DrawRect(0, 0, w, h)

surface.DrawRect(3, 3, w - 6, 1)

function cutta_inventory_system:Paint_REButton(pan, w, h)
local theme = cis_re_theme
local fill = theme.panelAlt
local border = theme.borderSoft
local textColor = theme.text

if pan.CIS_Variant == "danger" then
fill = Color(52, 21, 19, 240)
border = theme.border
elseif pan.CIS_Variant == "success" then
fill = Color(23, 38, 29, 240)
border = theme.success
elseif pan.CIS_Variant == "warning" then
fill = Color(50, 32, 20, 240)
border = theme.warning
end

if pan.CIS_IsActive then
fill = Color(60, 38, 28, 245)
border = theme.borderBright
elseif pan:IsHovered() then
fill = Color(fill.r + 8, fill.g + 8, fill.b + 8, fill.a)
border = theme.border
end

surface.SetDrawColor(border)
surface.DrawRect(0, 0, w, h)
draw.RoundedBox(0, 2, 2, w - 4, h - 4, fill)

if pan:IsHovered() or pan.CIS_IsActive then
draw.RoundedBox(0, 2, 2, w - 4, h - 4, Color(255, 255, 255, 6))
end

draw.SimpleText(pan.CIS_Text or "", "cis_re_body", w * 0.5, h * 0.5, textColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
end

local labelColor = theme.muted

labelColor = theme.text
elseif pan.CIS_State == "locked" then
fill = theme.slotLocked
border = theme.warning
labelColor = theme.warning
elseif pan.CIS_State == "invalid" then

labelColor = theme.text
end

surface.SetDrawColor(border)
surface.DrawRect(0, 0, w, h)
draw.RoundedBox(0, 3, 3, w - 6, h - 6, fill)
draw.RoundedBox(0, 3, h - 22, w - 6, 19, Color(9, 10, 12, 220))

if pan:IsHovered() then

end

surface.SetDrawColor(theme.borderBright)

function cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(panel, modelPath, camScale)
if not IsValid(panel) then return end

panel:SetModel((isstring(modelPath) and modelPath != "") and modelPath or "models/error.mdl")
panel:SetFOV(26)

if not IsValid(panel.Entity) then return end

local mins, maxs = panel.Entity:GetRenderBounds()
local size = math.max(math.abs(mins.x) + math.abs(maxs.x), math.abs(mins.y) + math.abs(maxs.y), math.abs(mins.z) + math.abs(maxs.z))
size = math.max(size, 16)

panel:SetFOV(math.Clamp(18 + (size * 0.08), 18, 42))
panel:SetCamPos(Vector(size * (camScale or 0.9), size * (camScale or 0.9), size * 0.6))
panel:SetLookAt((mins + maxs) * 0.5)

function panel:LayoutEntity()
return
end
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferFromUI(securitycode)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]

local activeCode = tostring(frame.PanelSecurityCode or "")
local code = tostring(securitycode or "")
if code == "" then
code = activeCode
end

-- If caller passed a stale/wrong code, prefer the active trade code.
if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then
code = activeCode
end

if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then return end

local offer = {}
if frame.plyinventory_layout and IsValid(frame.plyinventory_layout) then
for _,itemPanel in ipairs(frame.plyinventory_layout:GetChildren()) do
if itemPanel.IsSelected and itemPanel.ItemClass and isstring(itemPanel.ItemClass) then
if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] and #offer >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] then
break
end
table.insert(offer, itemPanel.ItemClass)
end
end
end

print("[CIS DEBUG] Player_TradeOfferFromUI - Offer:", table.ToString(offer))

-- Instant local UI feedback: update "Your Offer" immediately.
frame.myAccepted = false
frame.otherAccepted = false
if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, offer)
end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferUpdate(code, offer)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeStateUpdate(securitycode, state)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]
if frame.PanelSecurityCode ~= securitycode then return end
if not istable(state) then return end

local myid = LocalPlayer():AccountID()
local myid_str = tostring(myid)

local my = state[myid] or state[myid_str] or {}
local other = {}

for k,v in pairs(state) do
if tostring(k) ~= myid_str then
other = v
break
end
end

frame.myAccepted = tobool(my.accepted)
frame.otherAccepted = tobool(other.accepted)

if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, my.offer or {})
end

if frame.othertrade_list and IsValid(frame.othertrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.othertrade_list, other.offer or {})
end
end

Explain Concepts - Boolean Values in Garry's Mod Lua.

Demonstrates how conditional statements treat booleans.

Example

Demonstrates how conditional statements treat booleans.
```lua
if false then print("Value is false!") end
if true then print("Value is true!") end
```

Inverting a boolean is often very useful. The easiest way to do that is to use the "not" operator.
```lua
local bool = false
if bool then
print("Boolean is false, this code is not run!")
end

// Boolean is now being inverted ( false -> true )
bool = not bool

if bool then
print("Boolean has been inverted and is now true!")
end

// This also works backwards. Note how "!" can be used in place of "not"
bool = !bool

if bool then
print("Boolean is false again, and won't be printed!")
end
```

local function option_already_added(restriction_name, restriction_value)
local restrictions = LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname]["Restrictions"]
if not istable(restrictions) then return false end

for _, restrictionEntry in pairs(restrictions) do
if not istable(restrictionEntry) then continue end
for restrictname, restrictValues in pairs(restrictionEntry) do
if restrictname ~= restriction_name then continue end

-- Backward compatible behavior: if no value provided, just check the restriction type exists.
if restriction_value == nil then
return true
end

if istable(restrictValues) then
for _, val in pairs(restrictValues) do
if val == restriction_value then
return true
end
end
else
if restrictValues == restriction_value then
return true
end
end
end
end
return false
end

function CUTTALEVEL:player_givexp(ply, amount)
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA] = {} end
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] = 0 end
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["totalexp"] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["totalexp"] = 0 end
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] + amount
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["totalexp"] = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["totalexp"] + amount
CUTTALEVEL:player_levelcheck(ply)
CUTTALEVEL:Hud_Visibility(ply, amount)
end

function CUTTALEVEL:player_levelcheck(ply)
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] = 1 end
if not ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skillpoints"] then ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skillpoints"] = 0 end
local xpToLevel = tonumber((CUTTALEVEL_CONFIG or {}).XPToLevel) or 150
local currentLevel = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"]
local requiredXP = xpToLevel * currentLevel

if ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] >= requiredXP then
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["exp"] - requiredXP
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"] = currentLevel + 1
ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skillpoints"] = ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["skillpoints"] + 1
CUTTALEVEL:player_levelcheck(ply)
ply:PrintMessage(HUD_PRINTTALK,"You Are Level "..tostring(ply[CUTTALEVEL_PDATA]["level"]))
else
CUTTALEVEL:playersave_data(ply)
end
end

In Garry's Mod Lua, what does chat.AddText do?

Adds text to the local player's chat box (which only they can read).

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- arguments: vararg. The message to be added to the chat box.

Arguments can be:
* Color - Will set the color for all following strings until the next Color argument.
* string - Text to be added to the chat box.
* Player - Adds the name of the player in the player's team color to the chat box.
* any - Any other type, such as Entity will be converted to string and added as text.

These argument types can be combined to create formatted messages.

Example

Prints the player's name and current weapon to their chat area.
```lua
local ply = LocalPlayer()
chat.AddText(
-- Sets the text color of upcoming strings to blue
Color( 100, 100, 255 ),
-- A Player whose name will be automatically colored according to their team color
-- Note: this will ignore the string color set on the line above
ply,
-- A string which will be colored blue because of the text color set above
", you are holding ",
-- Sets the text color to green
Color( 100, 255, 100 ),
-- A string which will be colored green
ply:GetActiveWeapon():GetClass()
)
```

local function CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateGridSize"] or 4) or 4), 1)

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()

local gridSize = CIS_GetLootCrateGridSize()

return gridSize * gridSize

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateUseDistance()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateUseDistance"] or 120) or 120), 48)

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateOpenedLifetime()

return math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateOpenedLifetime"] or 300) or 300), 1)

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateLayout(ent)

if not IsValid(ent) then return nil end
if ent:GetClass() != "cis_inv_lootcrate" then return nil end

local slotCount = CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()
local layout = istable(ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout) and ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout or {}
local normalizedLayout = {}

for index = 1, slotCount do

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(layout[index])

local itemData = class and cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] or nil

if class and itemData and itemData.Type != "weapon" then

normalizedLayout[index] = {

Class = class,

Amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(layout[index]),

}

else

normalizedLayout[index] = {}

end

end

ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout = normalizedLayout
ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode = isstring(ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode) and ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode or cutta_inventory_system:Player_SecurityCode()

return normalizedLayout

end

local function CIS_GetLootCrateRandomItemClasses()

local classes = {}

for class, itemData in pairs(cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"] or {}) do

if isstring(class) and class != "" and istable(itemData) and itemData.Type != "weapon" then

classes[#classes + 1] = class

end

end

table.sort(classes)

return classes

end

local function CIS_ReleaseLootCratesForPlayer(ply)

for _, ent in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("cis_inv_lootcrate")) do

if IsValid(ent) and ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter == ply then

ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter = nil

end

end

end

local function CIS_IsLootCrateEmpty(ent)

local layout = CIS_GetLootCrateLayout(ent)

if not layout then return true end

return cutta_inventory_system:Count_InventoryOccupiedSlots(layout) <= 0

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_BuildRandomLayout()

local slotCount = CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()
local itemClasses = CIS_GetLootCrateRandomItemClasses()

if slotCount <= 0 or #itemClasses <= 0 then return {} end

local minStacks = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateMinItemStacks"] or 4) or 4), 1)
local maxStacks = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateMaxItemStacks"] or slotCount) or slotCount), minStacks)
local minAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateMinStackAmount"] or 1) or 1), 1)
local maxAmount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["LootCrateMaxStackAmount"] or 25) or 25), minAmount)
local stackCount = math.random(math.min(minStacks, slotCount), math.min(maxStacks, slotCount))
local slotOrder = {}
local classPool = table.Copy(itemClasses)
local layout = {}

for index = 1, slotCount do

slotOrder[index] = index

end

for index = #slotOrder, 2, -1 do

local swapIndex = math.random(index)

slotOrder[index], slotOrder[swapIndex] = slotOrder[swapIndex], slotOrder[index]

end

for entryIndex = 1, stackCount do

if #classPool <= 0 then

classPool = table.Copy(itemClasses)

end

local classIndex = math.random(#classPool)
local class = classPool[classIndex]

table.remove(classPool, classIndex)

layout[slotOrder[entryIndex]] = {

Class = class,

Amount = math.random(minAmount, maxAmount),

}

end

return layout

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_EnsureState(ent)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if ent:GetClass() != "cis_inv_lootcrate" then return false end

if not istable(ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout) then

ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout = cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_BuildRandomLayout()

end

return CIS_GetLootCrateLayout(ent) != nil

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Prune(ent)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if ent:GetClass() != "cis_inv_lootcrate" then return false end
if not cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_EnsureState(ent) then

ent:Remove()

return true

end

if CIS_IsLootCrateEmpty(ent) then

ent:Remove()

return true

end

if ent.CIS_LootCrateOpenedAt and (CurTime() - ent.CIS_LootCrateOpenedAt) >= CIS_GetLootCrateOpenedLifetime() then

ent:Remove()

return true

end

return false

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return false end
if cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Prune(ent) then return false end
if not cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_EnsureState(ent) then return false end

net.Start(cutta_inventory_system["StringName"].."LootCrate_Sync")
net.WriteInt(ent:EntIndex(), 32)
net.WriteString(ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode or "")
net.WriteTable(ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout or {})
net.Send(ply)

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_CanInteract(ply, ent, securityCode, shouldMessage)

if not IsValid(ply) or not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if ent:GetClass() != "cis_inv_lootcrate" then return false end
if cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Prune(ent) then return false end

if isstring(securityCode) and securityCode != "" and securityCode != (ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode or "") then

if shouldMessage then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Loot crate session expired")

end

return false

end

if ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter and ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter != ply then

if shouldMessage then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Someone else is using this loot crate")

end

return false

end

local maxDistance = CIS_GetLootCrateUseDistance()

if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(ent:GetPos()) > (maxDistance * maxDistance) then

if shouldMessage then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Move closer to the loot crate")

end

return false

end

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Open(ply, ent)

if not cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_CanInteract(ply, ent, nil, true) then return false end

ent.CIS_LootCrateOpenedAt = ent.CIS_LootCrateOpenedAt or CurTime()
ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter = ply

return cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Close(ply, ent, securityCode)

if not IsValid(ent) then return false end
if ent:GetClass() != "cis_inv_lootcrate" then return false end

if isstring(securityCode) and securityCode != "" and securityCode != (ent.CIS_LootCrateSecurityCode or "") then

return false

end

if ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter == ply then

ent.CIS_LootCrateLooter = nil

end

return true

end

function cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_MoveToInventory(ply, ent, securityCode, fromIndex, targetIndex)

if not cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_CanInteract(ply, ent, securityCode, true) then

cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Close(ply, ent, securityCode)

return false

end

local layout = CIS_GetLootCrateLayout(ent)
local slotCount = CIS_GetLootCrateSlotCount()

if not layout then return false end

fromIndex = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(fromIndex) or 0), 0)
targetIndex = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(targetIndex) or 0), 0)

if fromIndex <= 0 or fromIndex > slotCount then

cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

return false

end

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(layout[fromIndex])
local amount = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(layout[fromIndex])

if not class or amount <= 0 or not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Items"][class] then

layout[fromIndex] = {}
ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout = layout

if cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Prune(ent) then return false end

cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

return false

end

local added = false

if targetIndex > 0 then

added = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_AddItemToTargetSlot(ply, class, amount, targetIndex)

if not added then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "Drop loot on an empty slot or matching stack")

end

else

added = cutta_inventory_system:Inventory_AddItemToLayout(ply, class, amount)

if not added then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_MessageSend(ply, "No room in inventory")

end

end

if not added then

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)
cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

return false

end

layout[fromIndex] = {}
ent.CIS_LootCrateLayout = layout

cutta_inventory_system:Player_Transfer(ply)

if cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_Prune(ent) then return true end

cutta_inventory_system:LootCrate_SendState(ent, ply)

return true

end

function ENT:Initialize()
self:SetModel(self.Model)

self:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS)
self:SetSolid(SOLID_VPHYSICS)

physics_object:Wake()
end

function ENT:Use(activator, caller)
local player_entity = IsValid(activator) and activator:IsPlayer() and activator or (IsValid(caller) and caller:IsPlayer() and caller or nil)

if not IsValid(player_entity) then return end
if (self.NextUseAt or 0) > CurTime() then return end

self.NextUseAt = CurTime() + 0.35

if not OUTBREAK_SYSTEM then return end

local activated = OUTBREAK_SYSTEM:ActivateTimedUtilityItem(player_entity, self.ItemKey, self:WorldSpaceCenter())

if not activated then return end

self:EmitSound("ambient/energy/zap1.wav", 74, 112, 0.85)
self:Remove()
end

local CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)

hook.Add("PostDrawTranslucentRenderables", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."PositionRing", function()
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questname = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system.Quests_GetQuestData and cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname) or nil
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if not objectives then return end

local objNumber = tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply))
local objData = objNumber and (objectives[objNumber] or objectives[tostring(objNumber)]) or nil
if not objData then return end
if objData.Obj_Name == "soundcue" or objData.Obj_Name == "musiccue" or objData.Obj_Name == "cutscene" then return end
if objData.Obj_Name ~= cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) then return end

local point = objData.position or objData["position"]
local distance = objData.distance or objData["distance"]
if point and distance then
cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(point, distance, color_white, 30, 8)
end
end
end)

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end
In Garry's Mod Lua, what does CLuaEmitter:Add do?

Creates a new CLuaParticle with the given material and position.

Realms
- Client

Arguments
- material: string. The particles material. Can also be an IMaterial .
- position: Vector. The position to spawn the particle on.

Returns
- value: CLuaParticle. The created particle, if any.

Example

Creates a simple spark particle effect 100 units above where the local player is looking at.
```lua
local tr = LocalPlayer():GetEyeTrace()
local pos = tr.HitPos + tr.HitNormal * 100 -- The origin position of the effect

local emitter = ParticleEmitter( pos ) -- Particle emitter in this position

for i = 0, 100 do -- Do 100 particles
local part = emitter:Add( "effects/spark", pos ) -- Create a new particle at pos
if ( part ) then
part:SetDieTime( 1 ) -- How long the particle should "live"

part:SetStartAlpha( 255 ) -- Starting alpha of the particle
part:SetEndAlpha( 0 ) -- Particle size at the end if its lifetime

part:SetStartSize( 5 ) -- Starting size
part:SetEndSize( 0 ) -- Size when removed

part:SetGravity( Vector( 0, 0, -250 ) ) -- Gravity of the particle
part:SetVelocity( VectorRand() * 50 ) -- Initial velocity of the particle
end
end

emitter:Finish()
```

local ui_theme = {
outline = Color(196, 35, 48),
edge = Color(74, 13, 18),
background = Color(8, 8, 10),
background_alt = Color(18, 10, 12),
surface = Color(31, 12, 16),
surface_alt = Color(48, 15, 21),
hover = Color(68, 18, 26),
hover_strong = Color(235, 74, 88),
hover_soft = Color(196, 35, 48, 58),
highlight = Color(255, 132, 132),
text = Color(237, 237, 239),
text_muted = Color(167, 154, 158),
danger = Color(255, 72, 72),
shadow = Color(0, 0, 0, 240)
}
local outline_color = ui_theme.outline
local background_color = ui_theme.background
local background_color2 = ui_theme.background_alt
local hovered_color = ui_theme.hover_strong
local hovered_color2 = ui_theme.hover_soft

local function with_alpha(col, alpha)
return Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, alpha)
end

local function get_panel_pressed(panel)
if not IsValid(panel) then return false end
if isfunction(panel.IsDown) then
return panel:IsDown()
end
return panel.Depressed == true or (panel.GetSelected and panel:GetSelected(panel)) or false
end

local function get_ui_wave(speed, min_value, max_value)
local sine = math.sin(CurTime() * speed)
local normalized = (sine + 1) * 0.5
return Lerp(normalized, min_value, max_value)
end

function cutta_ui_library:PaintSurface(w,h,fill,accent,image)
local accent_col = accent or outline_color
local panel_fill = fill or background_color
local pulse_alpha = get_ui_wave(1.6, 24, 52)
local sweep_width = math.max(64, math.floor(w * 0.24))
local sweep_x = math.floor((CurTime() * 110) % (w + sweep_width)) - sweep_width
local top_strip_h = math.max(12, math.floor(h * 0.12))

draw.RoundedBox(2,0,0,w,h,with_alpha(ui_theme.shadow,235))
draw.RoundedBox(2,1,1,w-2,h-2,panel_fill)
self:BoxOutline(w,h,accent_col)

surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(ui_theme.edge, 220))
surface.DrawRect(1,1,w-2,top_strip_h)

surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(accent_col, pulse_alpha))
surface.DrawRect(1,1,math.max(42, math.floor(w * 0.22)),2)

surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(ui_theme.highlight, 26))
surface.DrawRect(1,top_strip_h,w-2,1)

local sweep_y = math.max(top_strip_h + 8, math.floor(h * 0.38))
surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(accent_col, 18))
surface.DrawRect(sweep_x, sweep_y, sweep_width, 8)

surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(accent_col, 75))
surface.DrawRect(1,h-3,w-2,2)

if image and self["ImageCache"] and self["ImageCache"][image] then
surface.SetMaterial(self["ImageCache"][image])
surface.SetDrawColor(255,255,255,10)
local size = math.min(w, h) * 0.45
surface.DrawTexturedRect(w - size - 18, 18, size, size)
end
end

function cutta_ui_library:PaintButtonSurface(w,h,hovered,pressed,accent)
local accent_col = accent or outline_color
local fill = background_color2
if hovered then
fill = ui_theme.hover
end
if pressed then
fill = ui_theme.surface_alt
end

self:PaintSurface(w,h,fill,accent_col)

local alert_alpha = hovered and get_ui_wave(4.5, 42, 92) or 26
surface.SetDrawColor(with_alpha(accent_col, alert_alpha))
surface.DrawRect(3,3,6,h-6)
end

function cutta_ui_library:ApplyBodygroups(ent, bodygroups)
if not IsValid(ent) or not istable(bodygroups) then return end
for _, bg in ipairs(bodygroups) do
local bgID = tonumber(bg.id or bg.index or bg.bodygroup)
local bgVal = tonumber(bg.value)
if bgID ~= nil and bgVal ~= nil then
ent:SetBodygroup(math.max(math.floor(bgID), 0), math.max(math.floor(bgVal), 0))
end
end
end

function cutta_ui_library:BodygroupsToString(bodygroups)
if not istable(bodygroups) or #bodygroups == 0 then return nil end
local maxID = 0
for _, bg in ipairs(bodygroups) do
local bgID = tonumber(bg.id or bg.index or bg.bodygroup)
if bgID and bgID > maxID then maxID = math.floor(bgID) end
end
local chars = {}
for i = 0, maxID do chars[i + 1] = "0" end
for _, bg in ipairs(bodygroups) do
local bgID = tonumber(bg.id or bg.index or bg.bodygroup)
local bgVal = tonumber(bg.value)
if bgID ~= nil and bgVal ~= nil then
chars[math.max(math.floor(bgID), 0) + 1] = tostring(math.max(math.floor(bgVal), 0))
end
end
return table.concat(chars)
end

function cutta_ui_library:PModel(parent, model, canfloat, bodygroups)
if not parent then return end

local modelPanel = vgui.Create("DModelPanel", parent)
modelPanel:Dock(FILL)
modelPanel:SetModel(model)

-- Apply bodygroups to the model entity if provided
if istable(bodygroups) and #bodygroups > 0 and IsValid(modelPanel.Entity) then
cutta_ui_library:ApplyBodygroups(modelPanel.Entity, bodygroups)
end
modelPanel.CuttaBodygroups = bodygroups

-- initial camera / control state
modelPanel.ModelAngle = 0
modelPanel.ModelPitch = 0
modelPanel.Distance = 225
modelPanel.Dragging = false
modelPanel.Panning = false
modelPanel.LastMouseX = 0
modelPanel.LastMouseY = 0
modelPanel.LookAtPos = Vector(-1, 0, 28.3)
modelPanel:SetFOV(45)
modelPanel:SetLookAt(modelPanel.LookAtPos)
modelPanel.CanFloat = canfloat and true or false

-- convenience: ensure attached table exists
modelPanel.AttachedModels = modelPanel.AttachedModels or {}

-- input handlers
function modelPanel:OnMousePressed(mc)
if mc == MOUSE_LEFT then
self.Dragging = true
elseif mc == MOUSE_RIGHT then
self.Panning = true
end
local mx, my = input.GetCursorPos()
self.LastMouseX = mx
self.LastMouseY = my
self:MouseCapture(true)
end

function modelPanel:OnMouseReleased(mc)
self.Dragging = false
self.Panning = false
self:MouseCapture(false)
end

function modelPanel:OnMouseWheeled(delta)
self.Distance = math.Clamp(self.Distance - delta * 5, 20, 500)
end

-- per-frame layout: update camera and compute model placement
function modelPanel:LayoutEntity(ent)
-- keep model animating
self:RunAnimation()

-- stable input coords
local mx, my = input.GetCursorPos()
local dx = mx - (self.LastMouseX or mx)
local dy = my - (self.LastMouseY or my)

if self.Dragging then
self.ModelAngle = self.ModelAngle + dx * 0.5
self.ModelPitch = math.Clamp(self.ModelPitch - dy * 0.5, -89, 89)
end

if self.Panning then
local panSpeed = 0.1
local right = Vector(1, 0, 0) * -dx * panSpeed
local up = Vector(0, 0, 1) * dy * panSpeed
self.LookAtPos = self.LookAtPos + right + up
end

local ang = Angle(self.ModelPitch, self.ModelAngle, 0)
local offset = ang:Forward() * -self.Distance

self:SetCamPos(self.LookAtPos + offset)
self:SetLookAt(self.LookAtPos)

if self.CanFloat and IsValid(ent) then
local t = CurTime()
local floatHeight = math.sin(t * 1.5) * 3
ent:SetPos(Vector(0, 0, floatHeight))
end

self.LastMouseX = mx
self.LastMouseY = my

if IsValid(ent) then
ent:SetAngles(Angle(0, 180, 0)) -- keep upright
-- Re-apply bodygroups each frame in case the entity was recreated
if istable(self.CuttaBodygroups) and #self.CuttaBodygroups > 0 then
cutta_ui_library:ApplyBodygroups(ent, self.CuttaBodygroups)
end
end

-- IMPORTANT: Do NOT DrawModel() here — drawing must happen inside Paint's 3D cam.
-- LayoutEntity's job is to update animations / transforms only.
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Full Paint override that opens a 3D camera, draws the model AND props
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
function modelPanel:Paint(w, h)
-- draw panel background (optional)

-- determine screen rect for 3D camera
local sx, sy = self:LocalToScreen(0, 0)
local camPos = self:GetCamPos()
local lookAt = self:GetLookAt()
local camAng = (lookAt - camPos):Angle()
local fov = self:GetFOV()

-- start 3D rendering for the panel
cam.Start3D(camPos, camAng, fov, sx, sy, w, h)
render.SuppressEngineLighting(true)
render.SetColorModulation(1, 1, 1)
render.SetBlend(1)

local ent = self.Entity
if IsValid(ent) then
-- ensure bones ready for attachment placement
ent:InvalidateBoneCache()
ent:SetupBones()

-- let LayoutEntity run (animations + cam already set in LayoutEntity)
pcall(function() self:LayoutEntity(ent) end)

-- draw the base model
ent:DrawModel()

-- draw attached clientsidemodels
local ply = LocalPlayer()
for id, cs in pairs(self.AttachedModels) do
if not IsValid(cs) then continue end

-- read per-attachment saved data (your system uses this table)
local data = ply and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] and ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][id]
if not data then
-- no placement data — just draw at entity origin (optional)
cs:SetPos(ent:GetPos())
cs:SetAngles(ent:GetAngles())
cs:SetupBones()
cs:DrawModel()
else
-- advance animation for pet attachments if configured
if data.petanimation then
local idx = cs:LookupSequence(data.petanimation)
if idx and idx >= 0 then
if cs:GetSequence() ~= idx then
cs:ResetSequence(idx)
cs:SetCycle(0)
end
cs:SetPlaybackRate(1)
cs:FrameAdvance(FrameTime())
end
end

-- apply scale (max is original size 1)
if cs.SetModelScale then
local scale = tonumber(data.scale) or 1
if scale ~= scale then scale = 1 end
scale = math.Clamp(scale, 0.05, 1)
cs:SetModelScale(scale, 0)
end

local boneName = data.boneselect
if boneName and ent.LookupBone then
local boneIndex = ent:LookupBone(boneName)
if boneIndex and boneIndex >= 0 then
local mat = ent:GetBoneMatrix(boneIndex)
if mat then
local bonePos = mat:GetTranslation()
local boneAng = mat:GetAngles()
local localPos = Vector(data.posx or 0, data.posy or 0, data.posz or 0)
local localAng = Angle(data.pitch or 0, data.yaw or 0, data.roll or 0)
local finalPos, finalAng = LocalToWorld(localPos, localAng, bonePos, boneAng)
cs:SetPos(finalPos)
cs:SetAngles(finalAng)
cs:SetupBones()
cs:DrawModel()
else
cs:DrawModel()
end
else
-- fallback: offset from model origin
local basePos = ent:GetPos()
local baseAng = ent:GetAngles()
local localPos = Vector(data.posx or 0, data.posy or 0, data.posz or 0)
local localAng = Angle(data.pitch or 0, data.yaw or 0, data.roll or 0)
local finalPos, finalAng = LocalToWorld(localPos, localAng, basePos, baseAng)
cs:SetPos(finalPos)
cs:SetAngles(finalAng)
cs:SetupBones()
cs:DrawModel()
end
else
cs:DrawModel()
end
end
end
end

render.SuppressEngineLighting(false)
cam.End3D()
end

-- helpful helper to add an attached prop (ensures SetNoDraw and stores local offsets)
function modelPanel:AddAttachedProp(id, propModelPath, initialData)
if not id or not propModelPath then return end

-- clean existing
if IsValid(self.AttachedModels[id]) then
self.AttachedModels[id]:Remove()
self.AttachedModels[id] = nil
end

local cs = ClientsideModel(propModelPath, RENDERGROUP_OPAQUE)
if not IsValid(cs) then return end
cs:SetModel(propModelPath)
cs:SetNoDraw(true) -- we draw it manually inside the panel
cs:InvalidateBoneCache()

-- store simple meta for later (consumer code writes offsets into LocalPlayer table)
self.AttachedModels[id] = cs

-- populate temp props if provided
if initialData and LocalPlayer() then
LocalPlayer()["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] = LocalPlayer()["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] or {}
LocalPlayer()["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"][id] = initialData
end

return cs
end

-- cleanup when panel removed
function modelPanel:OnRemove()
for id, cs in pairs(self.AttachedModels or {}) do
if IsValid(cs) then cs:Remove() end
end
self.AttachedModels = {}
end

return modelPanel
end

-- Custom Drop Down Box Selection

local PANEL = {}
function PANEL:Init()
self.BackgrndCol = with_alpha(ui_theme.background, 248)
self.Items = {}
self:MakePopup()
self.Scroll = cutta_ui_library:VScrollPanel(self)
end

function PANEL:AddOption(text, func, icon)
local parent = IsValid(self.Scroll) and self.Scroll or self
local btn = vgui.Create("DButton", parent)
btn:SetTall(26)
btn:Dock(TOP)
btn:DockMargin(0, 0, 0, 0)
btn:SetText("")
btn.Text = text
btn.DoClick = function()
if func then func() end
self:Remove()
end

btn.Paint = function(s, w, h)
cutta_ui_library:PaintButtonSurface(w,h,s:IsHovered(),get_panel_pressed(s),outline_color)

if icon and icon != ""then
surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255)
surface.SetMaterial(Material(icon))
surface.DrawTexturedRect(6, 5, 16, 16)
draw.SimpleText(text, "css_ButtonText", 30, h / 2, ui_theme.text, TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
else
draw.SimpleText(text, "css_ButtonText", 10, h / 2, ui_theme.text, TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER)
end
end

table.insert(self.Items, btn)
return btn
end

function PANEL:AddSpacer()
local spacer = vgui.Create("DPanel", self)
spacer:SetTall(4)
spacer:Dock(TOP)
spacer.Paint = nil
end

function PANEL:OpenAt(x, y)
self:SetPos(x, y)

local totalHeight = 0
local longesttext = 0
surface.SetFont("css_ButtonText")
for _, item in ipairs(self.Items) do
totalHeight = totalHeight + (IsValid(item) and item:GetTall() or 0)
local textw = surface.GetTextSize(item.Text or "")
-- add padding for icon space and internal text margins
textw = textw + 24
if textw > longesttext then
longesttext = textw
end
end
local maxHeight = math.floor(ScrH() * 0.7)
local finalHeight = math.min(totalHeight, maxHeight)
if y + finalHeight > ScrH() - 10 then
y = math.max(10, ScrH() - finalHeight - 10)
self:SetPos(x, y)
end
local finalWidth = math.max(longesttext, 90)
-- ensure menu stays within screen width
if x + finalWidth > ScrW() - 10 then
x = math.max(10, ScrW() - finalWidth - 10)
self:SetPos(x, y)
end
if x < 0 then
x = 10
self:SetPos(x, y)
end
self:SetSize(finalWidth, finalHeight)
if IsValid(self.Scroll) then
self.Scroll:Dock(FILL)
end
end

function PANEL:Paint(w, h)
cutta_ui_library:PaintSurface(w,h,self.BackgrndCol,ui_theme.highlight)
end

function PANEL:Think()
local function ishovereditems()
for _, btns in ipairs(self.Items) do
if (IsValid(btns) and btns:IsHovered()) or (IsValid(self.Scroll) and self.Scroll:IsHovered()) or input.IsMouseDown(MOUSE_LEFT) then
return true
end
end
return false
end
if timer.Exists("cutta_ui_library_DropDownBox_Remove_"..tostring(self)) then return end
if self:IsValid() then
local inside = self:IsHovered() or (IsValid(self.Scroll) and self.Scroll:IsHovered())
if ishovereditems() and inside then
return
end
end
timer.Create("cutta_ui_library_DropDownBox_Remove_"..tostring(self), 1, 1, function()
if self:IsValid() then
local inside = self:IsHovered() or (IsValid(self.Scroll) and self.Scroll:IsHovered())
if not ishovereditems() and not inside then
self:Remove()
end
end
end)
end

vgui.Register("cutta_ui_library_DropDownBox", PANEL, "EditablePanel")
